`final class ResourceAnimation`<br/>

## Creation details

<a id="ResourceAnimation-factory-of"></a>

### of

`ResourceAnimation of(int width, int height, int plays, List<ResourceAnimationFrame> frames)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: An animation needs at least one frame, got none: check that the file holds its frames

Creates an animation of `width` × `height` pixels that plays `plays` times (`0` forever) through `frames`.
A frame shorter than 1 ms lasts 1 ms.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when `frames` is empty.
